groups.title: Temporal tiā verbstems
groups.proposal: Build intransitive temporal tiā VNCs from typed time-segment NNC Sources.
groups.readingJob: Show time-segment Source, temporal operation, class, boundary, and finite Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The time-segment Source is supplied; temporal meaning and realization follow the licensed route.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not confuse temporal tiā with transitive tia formations by spelling.

groups.title: Causative and intransitive tla
groups.proposal: Keep causative tla and intransitive become-tla as distinct typed verbalizations with their own participant graphs.
groups.readingJob: Show tla operation, transitivity, participants, class, continuations, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The licensed tla operation is selectable; objects and continuation effects are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not merge homophonous tla routes or authorize from an example stem.

groups.title: Intransitive o-ā and applicative huiā
groups.proposal: Pair Class C intransitive o-ā use/produce routes with their single- or double-object huiā counterparts.
groups.readingJob: Show use or production meaning, object structure, class, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Use versus production and licensed object realization are genuine route choices.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not read applicative object structure from the surface suffix alone.

groups.title: Adverbial huiā
groups.proposal: Build adverbial huiā VNCs only from typed adverbial nounstems and preserve their Source rank.
groups.readingJob: Show adverbial Source, huiā operation, valence, class, and finite Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The adverbial Source analysis is supplied; compatible realization is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not license arbitrary nounstems as adverbial Sources.

groups.title: Relational o-ā and huiā
groups.proposal: Build relational denominal VNCs from typed relational compounds or predicates with transitive, intransitive, and huiā projections.
groups.readingJob: Show relational Source, participant projection, operation, class, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Relational Source and licensed valence route are choices; participant effects are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not erase relational Source structure during verbalization.

groups.title: i-hui and a-hui with o-ā causatives
groups.proposal: Build Class B i-hui/a-hui intransitives and continue exact eligible Results into Class C o-ā causatives.
groups.readingJob: Show Source operation, exact continuation, class transition, boundary, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The licensed intransitive route is selected; causative availability follows the exact upstream Result.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not invent a causative for an ineligible or copied upstream frame.

groups.title: Transitive denominal i-ā
groups.proposal: Build transitive denominal i-ā VNCs from typed nounstem-plus-stock-i Sources while preserving supportive-vowel and competing-huiā analyses.
groups.readingJob: Show Source rank, i status, object relation, class, boundary, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Source analysis and licensed operation are choices; supportive i and surface realization are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not treat every surface i before ā as the same grammatical element.
